name: MINGLE [Carousel Game]
desc:
Yes this is from Squid Game 2! Inspired obvi!

The host will call out a number! It is your job to get that amount of people in one room, no more or no less or you will be eliminated!

PRESS F to push people! (Only works from the player count announcement till the timer ends)

VC Servers are located in the top left of your screen
